question: Please provide a list of the top three revenue-generating films for each actor, along with the average revenue per actor in those films, calculated by dividing the total film revenue equally among the actors for each film.
sql:
WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT i.film_id, SUM(p.amount) as film_revenue
    FROM payment p
    JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    GROUP BY i.film_id
),
actor_count_per_film AS (
    SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) as actor_count
    FROM film_actor
    GROUP BY film_id
),
actor_film_with_stats AS (
    SELECT fa.actor_id, fr.film_id, fr.film_revenue, ac.actor_count,
           fr.film_revenue / ac.actor_count as revenue_per_actor
    FROM film_actor fa
    JOIN film_revenue fr ON fa.film_id = fr.film_id
    JOIN actor_count_per_film ac ON fa.film_id = ac.film_id
),
ranked_films AS (
    SELECT actor_id, film_id, film_revenue, actor_count, revenue_per_actor,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY actor_id ORDER BY film_revenue DESC) as rn
    FROM actor_film_with_stats
),
actor_top3_avg AS (
    SELECT actor_id,
           AVG(revenue_per_actor) as avg_revenue_per_actor
    FROM ranked_films
    WHERE rn <= 3
    GROUP BY actor_id
)
SELECT a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name, 
       r.film_id, r.film_revenue, r.revenue_per_actor,
       t.avg_revenue_per_actor as average_revenue_per_actor
FROM ranked_films r
JOIN actor_top3_avg t ON r.actor_id = t.actor_id
JOIN actor a ON r.actor_id = a.actor_id
WHERE r.rn <= 3
ORDER BY r.actor_id, r.rn
